title: The Treatment of Insomnia in Patients With HIV Disease
brief_summary: This study is designed to evaluate the efficacy of two commonly prescribed sleep aids for use in patients who are HIV positive and suffer from insomnia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Insomnia
* HIV Seropositive
* Stable HIV Disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other psychiatric illnesses
* Unstable HIV disease
